corpus.title: Deployment runbook (2025)
corpus.body: Deployments go through CodeDeploy with blue-green instance groups. The pipeline waits for the old fleet to drain before traffic shifts.

corpus.title: Deployment runbook (updated June 2026)
corpus.body: Since 2026-06 deployments run on ECS with rolling updates. CodeDeploy was retired; the pipeline now watches ECS service stabilization instead of instance draining.

corpus.title: Repo tooling notes (2025)
corpus.body: Python linting uses pylint with the shared config in tools/pylint.ini. Pre-commit runs pylint on changed files.

corpus.title: Repo tooling notes (updated August 2026)
corpus.body: Since 2026-08 the repo lints with ruff. The pylint config was deleted and pre-commit now runs ruff check on changed files.

corpus.title: Storage architecture (2025)
corpus.body: The primary datastore is MongoDB. Services read and write through the shared mongoose models package.

corpus.title: Storage architecture (updated March 2026)
corpus.body: PostgreSQL is the primary datastore as of 2026-03, accessed through Kysely migrations. MongoDB remains only for legacy session archives.

corpus.title: Team rituals (2025)
corpus.body: Daily standup runs at 09:30 UTC in the engineering voice channel.

corpus.title: Team rituals (updated July 2026)
corpus.body: Since 2026-07 daily standup runs at 16:00 UTC to include the Warsaw team. The 09:30 slot was dropped.

corpus.title: Incident process (2025)
corpus.body: Incident paging goes through PagerDuty service rotations with a weekly handoff on Mondays.

corpus.title: Incident process (updated May 2026)
corpus.body: Since 2026-05 incident paging runs through Helix with NOC-first triage. PagerDuty is kept read-only for historical reports.

corpus.title: Feature flags
corpus.body: Feature flags are managed through the flag SDK; flags default to disabled and roll out by percentage.

corpus.title: Local retrieval notes
corpus.body: Local memory retrieval uses a hybrid of vector similarity and BM25 keyword ranking fused together.

corpus.title: Runbook index
corpus.body: Operational runbooks live in the wiki and are indexed by service name and symptom keyword.

corpus.title: CI pipeline
corpus.body: CI runs lint on Linux and the hermetic test subset on macOS. Test jobs run on multiple Python versions.
